preoutcome_geometry.distance: minimum Cayley word length under frozen C/S/E from a chain board-trigger to an exact observed member trigger of a nontrivial P7 development orbit
preoutcome_geometry.family_margin: nearest same-polarity non-family development-prototype distance minus nearest nontrivial-family distance; unreachable rival distance is capped at 4
preoutcome_geometry.specificity: distance gap between nearest and second-nearest nontrivial P7 family, capped at 4; unreachable second family receives cap

positivity_gate.target_definition: strictly higher graded-recoverability rank than matched control within the same source and polarity profile
positivity_gate.control_definition: lower-ranked chain-eligible position; binary non-membership is not required
hold_if: no strict rank variation in either source
fewer than 6 matched rank-separated pairs in either source

authority_ceiling: P9 may establish discriminative pre-outcome recoverability geometry and acquisition enrichment only. It may not admit a mechanism family or infer a transportable law, objective chess truth, human cognition, or human utility.
